cohort: 10,300 patients with at least one previous cesarean section undergoing hysterectomy for benign indications
finding: Patients with a previous cesarean section who underwent vaginal hysterectomy experienced a lower risk of surgical complications compared to those who underwent abdominal or laparoscopic hysterectomy.
mod_finding: Patients with a previous cesarean section undergoing vaginal hysterectomy experienced lower risk of surgical complications than those undergoing either abdominal or laparoscopic hysterectomy.
